messages.content: 你是严格但建设性的 ICLR 评审。评估这条宽主张是否可以作为一篇 world-model security 论文主线。可以接受它是“安全性质/威胁机制”而不要求每个载体都受害，但必须给出严格的可证伪不变量和足够新颖的机制边界。区分已有 trajectory poisoning/backdoor、rollout compounding、action insensitivity、goal-metric mismatch、Context Collapse、counterfactual consistency 工作。返回JSON字段：novelty,mechanism_specificity,breadth,actionability,prior_art_overlap,verdict(ACCEPT_AS_MAIN/ACCEPT_AS_EVALUATION/REJECT),reason,precise_claim_revision,minimum_evidence_matrix。分数0-10。

{"claim": "世界模型的安全边界不是事实转移的预测误差，而是事实支持到未执行反事实分支的完整性：合法轨迹更新可以在保持已执行一步预测、奖励和策略行为正常的同时，改变未执行动作序列的可达性/排序；这种“事实—反事实支持断裂”会在短视规划中造成任务失败，并可由分支支持审计和面向可达性的代价修复。", "existing_evidence": ["TD-MPC2 cheetah-run cascade -> walker-run held-out loss with one-step ratio 0.922 and shuffled controls, but no independent family/causal intervention", "TD-MPC2 reacher-easy and other source/task gates negative", "WorldAgen indirect goal dependence without task harm", "ActSWM Context Collapse and single-zero hinge overlap", "LeWorldModel/TwoRoom objective metric inversion is directly reported by recent work", "FACT teacher-forced action mismatch rejected as exposure bias"], "requirements": ["one sentence broad claim", "novelty self-assessment >=7 but honest prior-art separation", "multiple core tasks, strong baselines, and a repair", "must not call source-seed-specific anomaly broad without evidence"]}
